"Russland versucht alles, um die Energie- und Wasserinfrastruktur zu zerstören, aber wir stehen an Ihrer Seite", sagte von der Leyen am Freitag bei einem gemeinsamen Auftritt mit dem ukrainischen Präsidenten Wolodymyr Selenskyj in Brüssel. Man habe zwar den Energie-Waffenstillstand von US-Präsident Donald Trump unterstützt. "Aber wir haben gesehen, dass Russland ihn nicht eingehalten hat, keine einzige Minute lang. "Deshalb müssen wir den Druck auf Russland erhöhen", beonte von der Leyen. Das 22. EU-Sanktionspaket sei in Arbeit. In Anspielung auf Trumps Diesel-Deal mit Russland sagte die Kommissionspräsidentin: "Und eines ist absolut klar: Wir werden keine Sanktionen aufheben, solange Russland den Krieg nicht beendet". Man werde auf dem zweiten EU-Gipfeltag, an dem Selenskyj teilnimmt, über die finanziellen und militärischen Bedürfnisse der Ukraine sprechen. Bis Jahresende sollen zudem alle Cluster - also zentralen Themengebiete - in den EU-Beitrittsverhandlungen mit der Ukraine geöffnet werden. Selenskyj bedankte sich für die "riesige" Hilfe der Europäer. Man müsse unbedingt auch über die nötige Hilfe für sein Land im Jahr 2027 sprechen. Seine Regierung werde daran arbeiten, die Voraussetzungen für die Eröffnung der beiden neuen Cluster in den Beitrittsverhandlungen zu schaffen.

item.title: South Africa dismisses appeals against exploration in TotalEnergies Block 3B/4B
item.description: South Africa's environment minister has dismissed a challenge lodged by conservationists against an environmental authorisation to allow exploration in TotalEnergies-operated Block 3B/4B off the country's West Coast.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: South Africa's environment minister has dismissed a challenge lodged by conservationists against an environmental authorisation to allow exploration in TotalEnergies-operated (TTEF.PA) Block 3B/4B off the country's West Coast. The decision by Environmental Affairs Minister David Maynier, dated October 13 and seen by Reuters, is the latest in a series of appeals and [USN:L8N44B0FO TEXT:"court actions"] that have stymied oil and gas exploration in Africa's largest economy. Some 47 individuals and environmental organisations, including Greenpeace Africa, appealed to overturn a 2024 decision by the Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources allowing up to five exploration wells to be drilled in the block. The environmental authorisation was granted to Africa Oil SA Corp, Ricocure (Pty) Limited and Azinam Ltd, with TotalEnergies and QatarEnergy later taking up participating stakes. Maynier dismissed all the appeals but imposed some conditions on the grounds of appeal dealing with assessments of food security and livelihoods of coastal communities. Under South African law, any party unhappy with his decision can apply to a court to have the decision judicially reviewed. TotalEnergies welcomed the decision and said it will work with authorities to ensure compliance, including on environmental monitoring and marine protection. Greenpeace Africa said the minister's decision to dismiss the appeals was a "critical failure" of environmental governance and a direct threat to South Africa's West Coast, where the highly prospective [USN:L8N4310UQ TEXT:"Orange Basin"] is found.

item.title: MSCI, its classifications and what they mean
item.description: Global index provider MSCI said on Friday it was considering downgrading Indonesia's stock market to "standalone" status from the "emerging market" category, dealing a major blow to Southeast Asia's biggest economy.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Global index provider MSCI said on Friday it was considering [USN:L4N46124S TEXT:"downgrading Indonesia's stock market"] to "standalone" status from the "emerging market" category, dealing a major blow to Southeast Asia's biggest economy. The news stunned investors and irked officials in Jakarta, sending stocks (.JKSE) and the rupiah currency tumbling, as the move is worse than a previous threat of downgrade to "frontier market" status. MSCI says it classifies its indices in four categories based on level of economic development, size and liquidity of the market and openness to investors. They are: DEVELOPED MARKETS This classification is for the most mature and accessible equity markets, with virtually unrestricted access for foreign investors, a very high flow of capital, efficient trading systems and stable regulatory frameworks. To qualify, a market must have a gross national income per capita that is 25% above the World Bank's high-income threshold for three consecutive years. The United States, Japan and Singapore fall in this category. EMERGING MARKETS Although MSCI's classification framework for "emerging market" does not have requirements of economic development, countries in this segment are typically those considered as emerging economies. The "emerging market" classification is for markets with significant openness to foreign ownership and ease of capital flows, but still with some limitations, compared to a "developed market". The market must also have a good and tested trading operational framework, among other features. Markets in this category include Brazil, China, India and South Korea. Indonesia is also one but its index weighting dropped to 0.4% at the end of September from 1.16% at the start of the year. FRONTIER MARKETS These are the smaller, less developed or less accessible equity markets. Only one company needs to meet MSCI entry requirements and the market must be somewhat open to foreign investors and have at least partial ability for capital to move in and out, with modestly efficient trading and stable institutional frameworks. This classification has a sub-category of "advanced frontier markets," which offer better accessibility to investors but are limited in size and liquidity. Markets in the "frontier" category include Vietnam, Pakistan and Morocco. "Advanced frontier markets" include European countries such as Latvia and Estonia. STANDALONE MARKET The MSCI "standalone market" index does not put markets in the "emerging" or "frontier" indices, but uses their criteria on size and liquidity. A reclassification to "standalone market" status may result from severe deterioration in market accessibility or size and liquidity. Newly eligible markets are also in this category. Markets categorised as "standalone" include Argentina, Panama and Ukraine. Indonesia, if moved here, would be the group's largest economy, at more than twice the size of Argentina, the next largest.

item.title: EU leaders rally around Zelenskiy as Trump calls Ukrainian strikes on Russia a 'disgrace'
item.description: European Union leaders are set to rally around President Volodymyr Zelenskiy at a summit on Friday as US President Donald Trump fired another salvo at Ukraine, calling its strikes on Russian refineries a "disgrace".
item.dc:creator: Bart Meijer, Philip Blenkinsop
item.content:encoded: European Union leaders are set to rally around President Volodymyr Zelenskiy at a summit on Friday as US President Donald Trump [USN:L1N46203J TEXT:"fired another salvo"] at Ukraine, calling its strikes on Russian refineries a "disgrace". The EU is hosting Zelenskiy in Brussels at one of the most difficult moments for Ukraine, with missiles and drones raining down on Ukrainian cities and fears that the US could pull back intelligence sharing and weapons support from Kyiv. Trump blindsided Zelenskiy last weekend by announcing that Ukraine and Russia had agreed not to target each other's energy facilities. Facing US midterm elections in November, Trump has blamed Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries for pushing up energy prices that could cost him at the ballot box. "We want to end this war as quick as possible. We don't see now signals from the Russian side that they are ready for this, to end this war, that's why we have to prepare for the winter," Zelenskiy said as he arrived at the summit. "The winter package is not only energy, it's also air defence and funding," Zelenskiy said, adding that he would discuss Ukraine's needs for the rest of this year and for 2027. PREPARATION FOR WINTER WILL BE ON AGENDA Ukraine struck a Russian oil refinery after Zelenskiy declared that Kyiv was [USN:L6N4610BB TEXT:"abandoning the energy ceasefire"] that Trump had announced, and criticised his willingness to strike deals with Moscow. "All he's doing is making the world oil price higher. Well, I think that's a disgrace," Trump said in an interview with the Newsmax news outlet, after Ukraine hit a refinery southeast of Moscow which helps to supply the Russian capital. The Trump administration is also considering easing sanctions on so-called shadow fleet vessels that have transported oil and petroleum products from countries including Russia, a US official said on Wednesday. EU leaders have hit out at Trump's diesel deal, though they are also grappling with soaring energy prices since the Iran war that exposed divisions between member states on day one of the summit on Thursday. Zelenskiy told Reuters earlier this month that Ukraine had agreed a plan with European partners that would allow it to close a $27 billion deficit in its military spending for this year, allowing it to order the drones needed to continue fighting at the start of 2027. However, Finance Minister Sergii Marchenko said recently Ukraine still faced an unfunded budget gap for next year of $32.6 billion – and that does not include an estimated $40 billion in direct military supplies from allies. "I am unhappy with the number of countries that have been willing to pledge new financial support to Ukraine. But we will see several countries pledging more military support soon," said Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten. "Today will be more about talking to Zelenskiy about how to deal with the complex diplomatic situation that has arisen and how to survive the winter." Asked about Trump's latest remarks, Jetten said, "This is not the right language. It is also in the interest of Trump to defend Ukraine in this war." PUTIN PLAYS DOWN EFFECT OF UKRAINIAN ATTACKS For Russia's part, President Vladimir Putin [USN:L1N4610T1 TEXT:"played down"] the effect of Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries, saying they had caused "nothing particularly significant". On the eve of Zelenskiy's appearance at the summit, Russia also [USN:L8N462091 TEXT:"moved to place local assets"] of French, German, Swedish and Dutch companies under temporary management, in retaliation for the EU's support for Ukraine. In the latest attacks, Russian drone strikes on the city of Kharkiv killed three people, according to local authorities, while strikes on the Volyn region bordering Poland left 370,000 people without power. Emergency power cuts were introduced in the Ukrainian capital Kyiv during Russian strikes, private energy provider DTEK said on X. Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever said Zelenskiy "will probably look everybody straight in the eye and say, thank you for the 90 billion, but that money is going to run out because a war is a very costly thing." "So are you, as a European family, still willing, ready and able to put your money where your mouths are and support Ukraine and keep Ukrainian society and Ukrainian defence up and running?" he said.

item.title: India's battered IT stocks head for best week in 18 years on earnings boost
item.description: Indian IT stocks were on course for their biggest weekly gain in 18 years on Friday, buoyed by stronger-than-expected quarterly revenue from major software exporters and a global selloff in AI-linked stocks that prompted investors to turn to Indian shares.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Indian IT stocks were on course for their biggest weekly gain in 18 years on Friday, buoyed by stronger-than-expected quarterly revenue from major software exporters and a global selloff in AI-linked stocks that prompted investors to turn to Indian shares. Here are some details: The Nifty IT index (.NIFTYIT) has risen 10.4% so far this week, putting it on track for its biggest weekly percentage gain since the week ended October 31, 2008, when it climbed 11.24% The rally has [USN:L4N4620JK TEXT:"outpaced"] all other major sectoral indexes and the benchmark Nifty 50 (.NSEI) , which has gained 2.6% this week "Markets are witnessing a sharp rebound, supported by a resurgence in IT stocks following strong quarterly results," even as other Asian markets plunged on a selloff in AI-linked stocks, said Ankur Punj, managing director of Equirus Wealth Tech Mahindra (TEML.NS) jumped 8% on Friday after its [USN:L4N46113L TEXT:"second-quarter revenue beat expectations"], aided by robust deal wins Wipro (WIPR.NS) rose 5.8% after [USN:L4N4610ZD TEXT:"reporting"] stronger-than-expected quarterly revenue, with signs that delayed large deals could support growth in the coming quarters The gains come as Indian IT services companies navigate concerns about artificial intelligence's potential impact on traditional outsourcing businesses As of 1:00 p.m. IST, Infosys (INFY.NS) gained 3.9% and Tata Consultancy Services (TCS.NS) rose 4.2%, while HCLTech (HCLT.NS) added 1%; Persistent Systems (PERS.NS) bucked the trend, falling 3.3% after brokerages flagged margin pressures from higher amortisation costs Despite this week's sharp rebound, the IT index remains down about 16% this year, underscoring the pressure on the sector before the latest rally

item.title: El nuevo Roadster de Tesla se da la vuelta en el aire gracias a propulsores de SpaceX
item.description: Tesla presentó el jueves un Roadster rediseñado, provisto de propulsores similares a los de un cohete, y anunció que comenzaría su producción en 2028, más de una década después de que mostrara por primera vez una versión de nueva generación de su deportivo eléctrico.
item.dc:creator: Abhirup Roy, Mrinmay Dey
item.content:encoded: Tesla (TSLA.O) presentó el jueves un Roadster rediseñado, provisto de propulsores similares a los de un cohete, y anunció que comenzaría su producción en 2028, más de una década después de que mostrara por primera vez una versión de nueva generación de su deportivo eléctrico. El vehículo blanco de dos plazas, desarrollado en colaboración con SpaceX —la empresa de cohetes del director ejecutivo Elon Musk—, subió boca abajo por una rampa gracias a un sistema de succión, giró en el aire y aterrizó utilizando los propulsores integrados. Más tarde, utilizó los propulsores para saltar por encima de un camión y otros vehículos, girando en el aire durante la maniobra. Algunos observadores interpretaron esta colaboración como un intento de Musk de despertar el interés por una fusión de las dos grandes empresas que controla, una idea que ha barajado al analizar sus puntos en común. Esta presentación proporciona a Tesla un vehículo emblemático tras años de incumplir los plazos del Roadster, pero se produce en un momento en que la empresa está centrando su atención en la tecnología de conducción autónoma y la robótica, y a pocos días de la publicación de los resultados del tercer trimestre, que según los analistas revisten mayor importancia para los inversionistas. "Fue una demostración de ingeniería sin valor comercial más allá de avergonzar a los fabricantes de automóviles tradicionales", dijo Gene Munster, socio director de Deepwater Asset Management —inversionista de Tesla—, en la red social X. "El evento del Roadster es un nuevo ejemplo de por qué Elon está deseando unir (Tesla) y (SpaceX)", añadió Munster. Musk ha restado importancia al papel del vehículo en las finanzas de Tesla, describiéndolo en 2023 como "una minucia" que no "supondría un cambio significativo desde el punto de vista financiero". Sin embargo, el automóvil sigue teniendo un gran peso simbólico. "Tesla no cuenta actualmente con un auto insignia, es decir, un vehículo de lujo de alto rendimiento diseñado para mostrar lo mejor de la ingeniería y la tecnología de un fabricante de automóviles. El Roadster será el nuevo auto insignia de Tesla", dijo el analista de Morningstar Seth Goldstein en una nota el mes pasado. Los espectadores y testigos se mostraron entusiasmados con el espectáculo del lanzamiento. "Fue la demostración de producto más alucinante que he visto nunca", publicó en X Sawyer Merritt, fan e inversionista de Tesla. "Acabo de verlo en persona y sigo preguntándome cómo es posible que no fuera IA". Musk y otros ejecutivos no especificaron ningún precio objetivo en el evento del jueves, aunque Tesla, hace casi una década, barajó un precio base de 200.000 dólares para el vehículo. La página de reservas de Tesla para el Roadster, tras el evento del jueves, mostraba una versión "Performance" del vehículo que requería un depósito de 50.000 dólares y una versión "Thrust" con "propulsores de aceleración" que requería un depósito de 250.000 dólares. Una variante "Rocket", que según Tesla es "solo por invitación", se describe como un modelo monoplaza con un "sistema de vuelo completo". "LA MITAD DE LA VELOCIDAD DEL SONIDO" El evento, celebrado en unas instalaciones de pruebas de SpaceX en McGregor (Texas), contó con todos los elementos propios de una presentación clásica de un producto de Musk: música dramática, humo, silbidos mecánicos y una cuenta atrás para el lanzamiento. "Esta es la culminación del increíble trabajo de los ingenieros de Tesla y SpaceX, que han colaborado estrechamente para crear algo que no se ha visto en ninguna película", dijo Musk, que lucía una hebilla de cinturón plateada de estilo wéstern con el logotipo de Tesla, ante una multitud entusiasta de aficionados e inversionistas. El Roadster puede acelerar de cero a 97 kilómetros por hora en menos de un segundo y alcanzar una velocidad máxima de más de 230.370 kilómetros por hora, según explicó Lars Moravy, jefe de ingeniería de vehículos de Tesla. "Sin duda, mucho más rápido aún", dijo un emocionado Musk. "Creo que hay que rozar la mitad de la velocidad del sonido". El Roadster también puede recorrer más de 480 kilómetros con una sola carga. Eso es menos de la mitad de lo que Musk prometió en 2017, cuando Tesla presentó por primera vez un prototipo del Roadster de segunda generación y anunció que las entregas comenzarían en 2020. El Roadster original, lanzado en 2008 y a la venta hasta 2012, fue el primer vehículo eléctrico de Tesla y utilizaba un chasis de Lotus Elise. Contribuyó a cambiar la visión que el mundo tenía de lo que podía ser un vehículo eléctrico. Desde entonces, la empresa se ha dado a conocer por sus SUV Model Y y Model X y sus berlinas Model S y Model 3. La presentación del Roadster de segunda generación se produce ante un cambio radical en el enfoque de Tesla, que pasa de fabricar automóviles para conductores humanos a centrarse en la tecnología de conducción autónoma basada en la inteligencia artificial y la robótica.

item.title: El vicepresidente económico de Venezuela dice que Centerview sigue siendo el asesor financiero del país
item.description: La empresa estadounidense de servicios financieros Centerview Partners sigue siendo la asesora financiera para la reestructuración de la deuda de Venezuela, dijo el viernes uno de los principales responsables económicos del país.
item.dc:creator: Rae Wee
item.content:encoded: La empresa estadounidense de servicios financieros Centerview Partners sigue siendo la asesora financiera para la reestructuración de la deuda de Venezuela, dijo el viernes uno de los principales responsables económicos del país. Calixto Ortega, vicepresidente sectorial de Economía de Venezuela, dijo a Reuters que estaban "muy satisfechos" con la empresa estadounidense, y añadió que había mantenido conversaciones con Centerview esta semana. Venezuela [USN:L6N4250XI TEXT:"anunció en mayo"] que había contratado a Centerview como asesor financiero tras poner en marcha una reestructuración de su deuda soberana y de la de la petrolera estatal PDVSA. En junio se informó de que el banco de inversión estadounidense Lazard (LAZ.N) estaba intentando sustituir a Centerview. Ortega dijo a Reuters, al margen de las reuniones anuales del FMI y el Banco Mundial en Bangkok, que Centerview seguía muy implicada en el proceso de reestructuración de la deuda. Esta semana, Ortega afirmó que Venezuela [USN:L6N4600SG TEXT:"esperaba publicar"] un análisis de sostenibilidad de la deuda "muy pronto", pero el proceso ha resultado más complicado de lo previsto. La reestructuración de la deuda del país, estimada entre 150.000 y 200.000 millones de dólares, podría ser la mayor de la historia y se ha visto complicada por una red única de acreedores.

item.title: Indonesia president's approval rating slides further to 44.5%, survey shows
item.description: The approval rating of Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto dropped further to 44.5% ahead of his two-year anniversary in office, a poll showed on Friday, with dissatisfaction over economic conditions and his flagship programmes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The approval rating of Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto dropped further to 44.5% ahead of his two-year anniversary in office, a poll showed on Friday, with dissatisfaction over economic conditions and his flagship programmes. Prabowo's rating has been falling since late last year in surveys by Saiful Mujani Research and Consulting (SMRC), with 51.1% approval in [USN:L4N43T0CU TEXT:"July"], 66.4% in March and 81.2% in [USN:L4N3WK02S TEXT:"November"] The polls had 1,213 respondents and an estimated margin of error of +/- 2.9% The decline in the October 1-10 survey came from dissatisfaction about economic and political conditions, law enforcement and implementation of Prabowo's [USN:L1N4530A5 TEXT:"free meals"] and village cooperatives programmes, SMRC's executive director Deni Irvani said The polls showed 50.8% of respondents believed economic conditions were bad and 43.1% felt they had worsened compared to last year High prices of staple foods were the most mentioned problem, followed by corruption and poverty, Deni said About 62% of respondents were dissatisfied with the free meals programme and 71.4% doubted Prabowo's village cooperatives policy would succeed "Rather than boosting Prabowo's popularity among public, the programmes made him less appreciated. It's a paradox," Deni said. Prabowo's signature free meals scheme has been marred by food poisoning cases affecting more than 50,000 people, plus allegations of corruption and poor governance

item.title: BOURSE L'Europe dans le vert, les craintes sur le secteur technologique s'apaisent
item.description: Les principales Bourses européennes sont orientées dans le vert vendredi avec la stabilisation des rendements obligataires, ainsi que le reflux des cours pétroliers et de l'or après le choc provoqué par le spécialiste de l'intelligence artificielle (IA) CoreWeave.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Les principales Bourses européennes sont orientées dans le vert vendredi avec la stabilisation des rendements obligataires, ainsi que le reflux des cours pétroliers et de l'or après le choc provoqué par le spécialiste de l'intelligence artificielle (IA) CoreWeave. À Paris, le CAC 40 (.FCHI) grappille 0,11% à 7.943,78 points vers 07h05 GMT. À Londres, le FTSE 100 (.FTSE) avance de 1,08% et à Francfort, le Dax (.GDAXI) prend 0,40%. L'indice EuroStoxx 50 (.STOXX50E) progresse de 0,44%, le FTSEurofirst 300 (.FTEU3) de 0,41% et le Stoxx 600 (.STOXX) de 0,24%, l'Europe étant relativement à l'abri des mouvements sur la technologie, au regard de la taille réduite de ce secteur dans le principal indice paneuropéen. Sur l'ensemble de la semaine, le CAC 40 gagne à ce stade 1,76% et le Stoxx 600 1,61%. Les contrats à terme à Wall Street préfigurent une hausse de 0,19% pour le Dow Jones (.DJI) , de 0,13% pour le Standard & Poor's 500 (.SPX) et de 0,07% pour le Nasdaq (.IXIC) au lendemain d'une séance volatile qui s'est achevée dans le vert. Le retour de l'accalmie sur les marchés financiers pourrait toutefois être de courte durée, le rebond des places boursiers asiatiques ayant coïncidé avec l'approche du week-end, probablement sous l'impulsion des investisseurs à la recherche d'achats à bon compte après la baisse brutale de jeudi. L'opérateur de centres de données CoreWeave (CRWV.O) , déficitaire, doit près de 50 milliards de dollars selon les données de LSEG, ce qui a alimenté les craintes concernant l'accumulation de dettes finançant le boom de l'IA. Jensen Huang, le directeur général de Nvidia (NVDA.O) , deuxième actionnaire de CoreWeave avec environ 10% du capital du groupe, a cependant tenter de minimiser jeudi soir ces craintes. "La solidité financière de CoreWeave s'améliore de jour en jour", a déclaré Jensen Huang à la presse lors d'un événement à Stockholm, ajoutant qu'il ne voyait pas la nécessité pour Nvidia de venir en aide à l'entreprise. "Je suis optimiste. Leur coût du capital est en fait en baisse", a-t-il ajouté. Cela a suffi a atténuer les craintes autour de CoreWeave, permettant aux valeurs technologiques de rebondir mais certains spécialistes, à l'image de Kyle Rodda, estiment que "les marchés mondiaux pourraient bien connaître une période prolongée de ce type de volatilité". "Le marché prend conscience du fait que la demande en IA et un modèle économique rentable sont deux choses très différentes", souligne pour sa part Axel Rudolph, chef analyste technique chez IG Group. "Si le coût du capital continue d'augmenter, même une forte demande pourrait ne pas suffire à protéger les acteurs les plus endettés", a-t-il mis en garde. LES ENTREPRISES ET LES INDICATEURS AU CENTRE DE L'ATTENTION Outre l'IA, les investisseurs continuent d'analyser les résultats d'entreprises après la publication en début de semaine des comptes des grands groupes financiers américains. Côté indicateurs économiques, l'inflation en zone euro et la production industrielle américaine sont à l'agenda, alors que les investisseurs cherchent des signes sur la trajectoire des taux des grandes banques centrales. Fidèle à son habitude, le président de la Réserve fédérale américaine (Fed), Kevin Warsh, s'est montré très discret vendredi sur le sujet à Bangkok, dans le cadre des réunions du FMI et de la Banque mondiale, répétant qu'il ne préjugeait pas de l'issue des réunions de politique monétaire. Les marchés estiment actuellement à environ 28% la probabilité d'une hausse des taux de la Fed à la fin du mois. Le gouverneur de la Banque d'Angleterre (BoE), Andrew Bailey, s'est lui montré un peu plus direct, affirmant que la flambée des prix de l'énergie due à la guerre en Iran n'avait jusqu'à présent eu qu'un impact limité sur l'inflation générale en Grande-Bretagne, mais qu'il était prématuré pour tirer des conclusions définitives. Aux valeurs, [USN:S8N41X06M TEXT:"Schneider Electric"] (SCHN.PA) monte de 1,20% à la faveur du relèvement pour la deuxième fois depuis le début de l'année de ses objectifs de résultat d'exploitation et de chiffre d'affaires 2026. [USN:FWN4611AW TEXT:"Kering"] (PRTP.PA) abandonne 0,71% alors que le groupe de luxe a annoncé jeudi le départ de Seán McGirr de son poste de directeur de la création chez Alexander McQueen. Groupe ADP (ADP.PA) cède 0,55%, l'opérateur aéroportuaire ayant annoncé s'attendre à ce que son trafic passagers 2026 à Paris soit en légère décroissance sur un an. Ailleurs en Europe, [USN:L6N4620CZ TEXT:"Unicredit"] (CRDI.MI) avance de près de 1% après avoir obtenu l'autorisation de la Banque centrale européenne (BCE) pour prendre le contrôle de Commerzbank (CBKG.DE) (+1,01%). UBS gagne 0,53% alors que des sources ont rapporté que la banque helvétique étudiait actuellement différents scénarios, notamment le transfert de son siège social ou une fusion avec une autre banque, en cas de mise en oeuvre en Suisse de nouvelles règles bancaires plus strictes.

item.title: Shippers' demand for lower-carbon marine fuels cools as IMO rules hang in balance
item.description: Shippers' appetite for lower-carbon marine fuels weakened this year as the fate of a regulatory emissions framework from the International Maritime Organization (IMO) remained cloudy while some are using carbon credits, industry executives said.
item.dc:creator: Jeslyn Lerh, Florence Tan
item.content:encoded: Shippers' appetite for lower-carbon marine fuels weakened this year as the fate of a regulatory emissions framework from the International Maritime Organization (IMO) remained cloudy while some are using carbon credits, industry executives said. IMO member nations are set to meet by early November on the formal adoption of a net-zero framework to guide the industry towards zero carbon emissions by 2050, after last year's vote to [USN:L6N3VY0IS TEXT:"delay the move"]. Demand for marine biofuel, a more readily available alternative fuel on which shippers have focused more, has softened this year at the world's largest bunker hub of Singapore. Marine biofuel sales at the port totalled about 603,000 tons between January and September, down 47% from the corresponding 2025 period, government data showed. Total 2025 volumes had more than doubled from 2024. "I don't expect the biofuel demand to increase so much until we have an IMO decision," said Jens Maul Jorgensen, a director of dry bulk shipowner Oldendorff Carriers. "If anybody wants to have just a slightly greener world, IMO will have to step up," he told Reuters. "What we see now at the moment is a surplus of (carbon) credit to the FuelEU Maritime, and that is competing with biofuel (uptake)," added Jorgensen, speaking on the sidelines of the Singapore International Bunkering conference (SIBCON). He was referring to an EU regulation that requires ships exceeding gross tonnage of 5,000 tons and calling at EU ports to reduce emissions. While the FuelEU Maritime regulation has supported biofuels uptake in the European bunker hub of Rotterdam, the demand increase fell short of expectations. "Some of the tax benefits in Europe have prompted a little more uptake on biofuels, but in general we are a little bit surprised about the lack of demand," said Peter Grunwaldt, chief executive at Cargill-Hafnia joint venture Seascale Energy. "Even though biofuels (post-Iran war) are cheaper than gasoil (on some occasions), we are seeing people stick with gasoil. That's a little bit of a surprise to us, that the demand is not greater," said Grunwaldt. Total bio-blended bunker sales at Rotterdam have risen 28% in the year's first half over the first half of 2025, port data showed. "We need clear regulatory signals for the industry to work with," said Jesper Sorensen, global head of alternative fuels at KPI OceanConnect. "Right now, the only regulatory things in place are the emissions trading system and the FuelEU." The US-Israeli war with Iran has prompted more shippers to continue [USN:L4N45Y0FP TEXT:"diversifying supplies"], however. "Shipowners who have ordered alternative-fuel tonnage and dual-fuel tonnage are building optionality into their fuel mix," added Sorensen. "The disruption in the Middle East has shown that optionality is a good thing." Fossil-based marine fuel prices this week are at least 70% higher than levels before the Iran war began in February.

item.title: India's Persistent Systems plans debut rupee debt sale to fund acquisition, bankers say
item.description: Indian IT firm Persistent Systems is set to raise up to 80 billion rupees ($842 million) through the sale of rupee-denominated bonds with multiple shorter-duration papers of up to five-year maturity, two merchant bankers said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Khushi Malhotra, Dharamraj Dhutia
item.content:encoded: Indian IT firm Persistent Systems (PERS.NS) is set to raise up to 80 billion rupees ($842 million) through the sale of rupee-denominated bonds with multiple shorter-duration papers of up to five-year maturity, two merchant bankers said on Friday. The company will sell bonds maturing in one year, two years, three years, four years and five years and is likely to go ahead with the issue later this month, the two bankers with direct knowledge of the matter added. They spoke on the condition of anonymity because they were not authorised to speak to the media, while the company did not reply to a Reuters email seeking comment. The information technology company will use the proceeds to refinance a bridge loan it had taken earlier in the year to acquire Germany-based technology services company Nagarro, the bankers added. Ratings agency Icra has assigned an AA-plus rating to Persistent Systems' bonds. The company has acquired a 94% stake in Nagarro and would look to buy out minority shareholders before delisting. The total funding requirement to buy 100% of Nagarro will be around $1.25 billion. Persistent Systems had earlier proposed to fund the acquisition entirely through debt, but it recently announced plans to raise equity of up to $450 million and the rest through debt, Icra said in its ratings note. The issue comes as another company, Sun Pharma (SUN.NS) , is also in talks to raise around 100 billion rupees through shorter-duration bonds, which it will use to repay part of the bridge loan it took to acquire New York-listed healthcare company Organon, [USN:L4N45K0OB TEXT:"Reuters reported"] last month. ($1 = 95.0300 Indian rupees)

item.title: Las bolsas europeas suben gracias al impulso de Schneider, a la espera de los datos de inflación
item.description: Las bolsas europeas se encaminaban el viernes hacia su mayor subida semanal desde agosto, después de que una serie de sólidos resultados empresariales y los indicios de estabilidad en los maltrechos valores tecnológicos mundiales reforzaron la confianza de los inversores.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las bolsas europeas se encaminaban el viernes hacia su mayor subida semanal desde agosto, después de que una serie de sólidos resultados empresariales y los indicios de estabilidad en los maltrechos valores tecnológicos mundiales reforzaron la confianza de los inversores. El índice paneuropeo STOXX 600 (.STOXX) subía un 0,3%, hasta los 641,75 puntos, a las 0708 GMT, situándose cerca de su nivel más alto en más de dos semanas. El índice de referencia registraba una subida superior al 1% en la semana. Schneider Electric (SCHN.PA) avanzaba un 1,4% después de que el grupo industrial elevara por segunda vez sus objetivos de beneficio bruto de explotación e ingresos para 2026. El sector industrial (.SXNP) se revalorizaba un 0,7% y se situaba entre los valores que más subían del índice. Los sólidos resultados de las empresas europeas contribuían a estabilizar los mercados al final de una semana volátil, marcada por una ola de ventas en los valores tecnológicos de mayor rendimiento ante las preocupaciones sobre la competencia china y el aumento de la financiación mediante deuda para desarrollar infraestructuras de inteligencia artificial. El fabricante de chips Aixtron (AIXGn.DE) avanzaba un 4,8% tras superar las estimaciones de entrada de pedidos para el tercer trimestre y confirmar sus previsiones anuales. Los inversores analizarán con lupa las cifras de inflación del IPCA de la zona del euro, que se publicarán durante el día, en busca de indicios sobre si se han atenuado las presiones inflacionistas derivadas de los elevados precios del petróleo.

item.title: ACG orders 75 Airbus A320neo jets in lessor's biggest purchase yet
item.description: Lessor Aviation Capital Group (ACG) has ordered 75 Airbus A320neo aircraft, its parent company Tokyo Century said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Lessor Aviation Capital Group (ACG) has ordered 75 Airbus A320neo aircraft, its parent company Tokyo Century (8439.T) said on Friday. Deliveries of the single-aisle narrowbody airliners are expected to take place between 2032 and 2035. The California-based lessor bought the aircraft for a total list price of around 1.856 trillion yen ($11.76 billion), though it said the actual acquisition cost could not be disclosed due to confidentiality obligations. This is ACG's largest order in its nearly 40-year history, CEO Thomas Baker said in a statement. ($1 = 157.8800 yen)

item.title: Vehicles from Geely brands to come with Google built-in services outside China

item.content:encoded: China's Geely Holding Group (GEELY.UL) said on Friday that vehicles from its portfolio of brands will feature Google's (GOOGL.O) in-car services, including Gemini, Play and Maps, in overseas markets. item.content:encoded: US-Notenbankchef Kevin Warsh versprüht Konjunkturoptimismus, hält sich zur Zinspolitik jedoch wie gewohnt bedeckt. In einem Gespräch mit IWF-Chefin Kristalina Georgiewa in Bangkok bekräftigte Warsh am Freitag, er nehme keine Zinsentscheidungen vorweg. Zugleich bescheinigte er der US-Wirtschaft Widerstandsfähigkeit angesichts zahlreicher Krisen in der Welt und hartnäckig hoher Inflation. Der Fed-Chef verwies auf einen Investitionsschub, der weit über den Bereich der Künstlichen Intelligenz (KI) hinausgehe. Er habe den Eindruck, dass die Wirtschaft an Stärke gewinne, sagte Warsh. Sie verfüge über "reichlich Rückenwind". Warsh zufolge zeigt die Weltwirtschaft eine Resilienz, die angesichts der Krisenherde weltweit vor einigen Monaten wohl kaum jemand so für möglich gehalten hätte: "Ich bin optimistisch – manche würden vielleicht sagen: naiv –, dass wir zumindest in den Vereinigten Staaten gestärkt aus dieser Phase hervorgehen werden." Die USA würden so besser in der Lage sein, weltweit beim Wirtschaftswachstum eine Führungsrolle einzunehmen. Im jüngst veröffentlichten Konjunkturbericht "Beige Book" der Federal Reserve heißt es, die Unternehmen behielten für die kommenden Monate weiterhin einen positiven Wirtschaftsausblick bei. Die Erwartungen deuteten jedoch eher auf ein leichtes Wachstum hin, das durch anhaltende Unsicherheiten belastet werde. INFLATION MACHT FED ZU SCHAFFEN Während sich der US-Zentralbankchef länglich zu den Konjunkturaussichten äußerte, zeigte er sich mit Blick auf den Zinsausblick zugeknöpft: "Ich halte nichts davon, jetzt schon zu sagen, was ich auf den verbleibenden Sitzungen in diesem Jahr tun könnte", erklärte er. An den Finanzmärkten wird erwartet, dass die Fed auf ihrer nächsten Sitzung Ende Oktober die Zinsen unverändert lässt und im Dezember die geldpolitischen Zügel anziehen wird. Im September hatte die Zentralbank die Zinsen erstmals seit rund drei Jahren angehoben. Damit habe die Fed deutlich gemacht, dass sie für Preisstabilität sorgen werde, sagte Warsh. Die Inflation hat sich im September mit 3,7 Prozent jedoch noch weiter vom Ziel der Fed von 2,0 Prozent entfernt.

item.title: UniCredit autorisé par la BCE à prendre le contrôle de Commerzbank
item.description: UniCredit a obtenu l'autorisation de la Banque centrale européenne (BCE) pour prendre le contrôle de Commerzbank , a annoncé jeudi soir la banque italienne, alors que son offre publique d'achat hostile a porté sa participation dans son concurrent allemand à 48%.
item.dc:creator: Valentina Za
item.content:encoded: UniCredit (CRDI.MI) a obtenu l'autorisation de la Banque centrale européenne (BCE) pour prendre le contrôle de Commerzbank (CBKG.DE) , a annoncé jeudi soir la banque italienne, alors que son offre publique d'achat hostile a porté sa participation dans son concurrent allemand à 48%. UniCredit avait besoin de l'accord de la BCE pour prendre livraison des actions de la Commerzbank apportées dans le cadre de cette offre de 45 milliards d'euros et pour faire avancer les plans de cette importante opération bancaire transfrontalière en Europe. UniCredit a déclaré que la BCE l’avait autorisée à franchir le seuil de 30% de participation dans Commerzbank et "à augmenter encore sa participation sans limite maximale". La banque italienne a ajouté qu’elle comptait prendre le contrôle de Commerzbank d’ici la fin de l’année avec environ 50% des droits de vote, après avoir mené à bien les "dernières démarches réglementaires et conditions" liées à son offre publique d’achat. UniCredit, qui exploite depuis 2005 l’établissement bavarois HVB en Allemagne, a commencé à investir dans Commerzbank il y a plus de deux ans, lorsque son directeur général, Andrea Orcel, s’est lancé dans une opération de rachat également envisagée par ses prédécesseurs. Malgré la forte opposition de Commerzbank et les critiques du gouvernement allemand, UniCredit a acquis suffisamment d’actions pour contrôler les décisions des actionnaires ordinaires, tout en restant en dessous du seuil de 50% qui l’obligerait à racheter les parts des actionnaires minoritaires de mBank, la filiale polonaise de l’établissement allemand. Andrea Orcel a demandé à la Commerzbank d’adopter la stratégie qu’il a élaborée pour relancer les bénéfices de la banque basée à Francfort à partir de janvier, tout en repoussant une fusion complète à 2029-2030.

item.title: BOJ chief flags inflation overshoot risk, stresses importance of 2% anchor
item.description: Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda on Friday reiterated the risks of underlying inflation overshooting the central bank's 2% target, stressing the growing importance of keeping price pressures anchored around that level.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda on Friday reiterated the risks of underlying inflation overshooting the central bank's 2% target, stressing the growing importance of keeping price pressures anchored around that level. In a speech read out by Deputy Governor Shinichi Uchida at a meeting of Japanese credit unions, Ueda said factors including tensions in the Middle East, AI-related demand and currency swings could affect Japan's economy and prices, pointing to a risk that underlying inflation could exceed the BOJ's price target. "The perspective of anchoring underlying inflation at around 2% has become more important than before," Ueda said, highlighting the need to ensure that any overshoot of the BOJ's target does not harm the economy. The speech, which largely repeated remarks Ueda [USN:L1N45S06F TEXT:"made"] earlier this month, comes ahead of the BOJ's October 29 and 30 policy meeting, when the central bank will release fresh quarterly growth and inflation forecasts that market participants will scrutinise for clues on the timing of the next rate hike. The BOJ raised its key rate to a 31-year high last month, while signalling that it had entered a phase focused on preventing underlying inflation from overshooting its target, raising the prospect of tighter policy.

item.title: Air traffic disrupted in Italy due to technical fault

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Air travellers were facing delays and cancellations across Italy on Friday due to a technical fault affecting air traffic control, which authorities said was not caused by malicious activity. Air traffic authority ENAV (ENAV.MI) said it introduced temporary restrictions on air traffic capacity after detecting anomalies overnight on the data transmission network supporting air traffic control services nationwide. Rome airports operator ADR said that "due to technical issues affecting air traffic control systems nationwide, flight delays and cancellations may occur," and advised passengers to contact their airline. Milan airports company SEA issued a similar notice. The source of the problem has been identified and efforts are under way to restore full operations, ENAV said.

item.title: Toyota expects Arene software platform to be in 10 million new vehicles, 50 models by 2030

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Toyota Motor (7203.T) expects its Arene software platform will be deployed in 10 million new vehicles annually and 50 car models by 2030, the company said on Friday, after the Nikkei reported the automaker aims to make those models software-defined by then. Chief Technology Officer Hiroki Nakajima outlined deployment plans for Arene at an investor briefing in Brussels last week, according to a Toyota spokesperson. Nakajima also said Toyota aims to expand the platform's deployment further as it moves towards 2035, including in vehicles from alliance partners, the spokesperson said. Toyota [USN:L4N3RT01L TEXT:"first introduced"] Arene in its revamped RAV4 sport utility vehicle, which was launched in 2025. Software-defined vehicles allow functions to be updated over the air after purchase, enabling automakers to add safety, autonomous driving and entertainment features without requiring customers to visit dealerships.

item.title: PetroChina set for record trading profit as war upends market, sources say
item.description: PetroChina is poised for a record year in trading profits, five trading executives said, with its refineries outside China reaping bumper margins amid tight global fuel markets as the Iran war transforms the way Middle East oil is bought and sold.
item.dc:creator: Chen Aizhu
item.content:encoded: PetroChina is poised for a record year in trading profits, five trading executives said, with its refineries outside China reaping bumper margins amid tight global fuel markets as the Iran war transforms the way Middle East oil is bought and sold. PetroChina (601857.SS) , Asia's largest oil and gas producer and China's second-biggest refiner, is cashing in on a large production and supply portfolio and an extensive refining and retail network that have helped insulate it from war-induced disruptions. Gross profits at the state company's trading vehicle PetroChina International (PCI) are expected to top 20 billion yuan ($3.0 billion) for 2026, a record, two of the people briefed on the matter said, speaking on the condition of anonymity as they are not authorized to speak with media. By early October, its crude oil division, which typically generates over half of PCI's profits, had more than doubled earnings for the whole of 2025, with fuel products and natural gas departments also performing strongly, one of the two trading executives said. PetroChina did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The Chinese refiner, which does not break out trading profits in its public financial results, posted a first-half [USN:L1N44R02M TEXT:"net profit"] of around $14.65 billion for the whole group in August. PCI's performance was in line with bumper trading earnings across the petroleum sector, with trading desks at European majors BP (BP.L) , Shell (SHEL.L) and TotalEnergies (TTEF.PA) [USN:L6N40Y0OM TEXT:"earning billions of dollars"] in the early months of the Iran war. [USN:L6N45Z0CU TEXT:"BP said this week"] it expects third-quarter gas marketing and trading results to significantly exceed those of the previous quarter, while its oil trading profit will be broadly flat from the second quarter in what has been a strong year. Total said on Thursday trading in both oil and gas will [USN:L6N4610DV TEXT:"drive earnings"]. ADVANTAGEOUS POSITION The Strait of Hormuz, a chokepoint for oil and gas trade flows that have been disrupted by the war, accounts for just [USN:L1N40I09U TEXT:"10% of PetroChina's system requirements"] for both crude oil and natural gas, Chairman Dai Houliang said in March. In contrast, domestic peer Sinopec (600028.SS) , the world's biggest refiner by capacity, has been more [USN:L1N40B08D TEXT:"vulnerable"] to the supply disruptions as it relies on the Middle East for roughly half its oil. PCI's crude trading gains have been driven by profits made on physical cargoes as Middle Eastern producers, excluding Iran, cut prices to export oil, said the one trading executive. Arbitrage trade, or cargo movements between regions, has also contributed to profits, the person said. PetroChina's trading is also supported by wide margins at its overseas refineries as both the Iran war and the Russia-Ukraine war have tightened fuel markets. PetroChina owns half of the 210,000-barrel-per-day Lavera refinery in France and half of a 285,000-bpd Singapore facility. The Iran war has prompted Gulf producers led by [USN:L1N44B00A TEXT:"Abu Dhabi National Oil Company"] to deploy shuttle fleets to ship oil across the Strait of Hormuz and sell via spot tenders. Before the war, buyers sent in ships to lift cargoes under annual supply pacts. Producers have also cut prices to offset soaring freight costs. Saudi Aramco recently lowered its official selling prices for Asian buyers to six-year lows, and Iraq's state oil marketer SOMO [USN:L1N45M07S TEXT:"deepened discounts"] to more than $30 a barrel for loading at its terminals. PetroChina, the largest foreign company producing oil in Iraq, is among those to have loaded discounted Iraqi oil inside the Gulf.

item.title: China dice que Israel debería poner fin al "establecimiento forzoso" de asentamientos en Cisjordania
item.description: El ministro de Asuntos Exteriores chino, Wang Yi, dijo al presidente israelí, Isaac Herzog, que Israel debería detener y revertir su "establecimiento forzoso" de asentamientos en el territorio bajo ocupación de Cisjordania, según informó el Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores de China en un comunicado emitido el viernes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El ministro de Asuntos Exteriores chino, Wang Yi, dijo al presidente israelí, Isaac Herzog, que Israel debería detener y revertir su "establecimiento forzoso" de asentamientos en el territorio bajo ocupación de Cisjordania, según informó el Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores de China en un comunicado emitido el viernes. China siempre ha defendido que la cuestión palestina es la mayor injusticia histórica de este siglo, según le dijo Wang a Herzog durante una reunión celebrada en Azerbaiyán, añadió el ministerio. Wang dijo que promover la paz y la reconciliación en la región es la "piedra angular" de la política china para Oriente Medio. China cree que la "solución de dos Estados" es el camino correcto hacia una resolución y que la prioridad inmediata es abrir plenamente el acceso a la Franja de Gaza para evitar que se extienda una "catástrofe" humanitaria, añadió Wang. Al mismo tiempo afirmó que Israel debería detener y revertir el establecimiento forzoso de asentamientos en Cisjordania. China está dispuesta a colaborar con la comunidad internacional para instar a todas las partes a que retomen el diálogo y las consultas lo antes posible y busquen una solución política al conflicto, añadió Wang. China lleva mucho tiempo apoyando la causa palestina y Pekín también mantiene estrechos vínculos con el principal enemigo regional de Israel, Irán.

item.title: El IBEX 35 sube ante la moderación de las apuestas de alzas de tipos de la Fed
item.description: El índice español IBEX 35 subía el viernes en una sesión sin grandes referencias, tras las fuertes ventas registradas en la jornada anterior, en la que los inversores se deshicieron de acciones tecnológicas ante los temores sobre la financiación que impulsa el auge de la inteligencia artificial.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El índice español IBEX 35 (.IBEX) subía el viernes en una sesión sin grandes referencias, tras las fuertes ventas registradas en la jornada anterior, en la que los inversores se deshicieron de acciones tecnológicas ante los temores sobre la financiación que impulsa el auge de la inteligencia artificial. Los mercados se aferraban el viernes a [USN:L6N4620BI TEXT:"las declaraciones"] del presidente de la Reserva Federal estadounidense en la cumbre del FMI y el Banco Mundial en Tailandia, que moderaron las expectativas de subidas de tipos. El presidente de la Reserva Federal, Kevin Warsh, se mostró optimista respecto a la solidez de la economía estadounidense y manifestó su sorpresa ante lo bien que las economías mundiales han "aguantado" frente a las recientes crisis geopolíticas, a pesar del endurecimiento de la política monetaria adoptado para combatir la inflación. Según la herramienta FedWatch de CME, los operadores están descontando una probabilidad del 28% de que se produzca una subida de tipos de interés este mes y del 89% de que se produzca un aumento en diciembre. "Para hoy tendremos pocas referencias con capacidad para mover mercado: Inflación final de la UEM (prelim.: +3,8%; subyacente +2,5%) y Producción Industrial de EE.UU. (+0,4% m/m esperado en Sept.)", dijeron los analistas de Bankinter en su canal de Telegram. "Tono positivo a primera hora y apoyado en el rebote de la Tecnología, que previsiblemente se mantendrá a lo largo de la sesión teniendo en cuenta que apenas habrá referencias macro de calado para cambiar el rumbo de la sesión." En el plano macroeconómico, el viernes se conocerán los datos finales de septiembre del IPC general y subyacente de la eurozona (0900 GMT) y las cifras de producción industrial de septiembre en Estados Unidos (1315 GMT). El foco de los inversores está en el inicio de la temporada de resultados la próxima semana, en la que destacan en España empresas como Iberdrola, Bankinter y Enagás, además de las estadounidenses Meta, RTX y Lockheed Martin, entre otras. A las 0714 GMT, el selectivo bursátil español IBEX 35 subía 83,80 puntos, un 0,44%, hasta 19.261,20 puntos, mientras que el índice de grandes valores europeos FTSE Eurofirst 300 (.FTEU3) avanzaba un 0,27%. En el sector bancario, Santander (SAN.MC) subía un 0,52%, BBVA (BBVA.MC) se anotaba un 0,61%, Caixabank (CABK.MC) avanzaba un 0,17%, Sabadell (SABE.MC) ganaba un 1,13%, Bankinter (BKT.MC) se revalorizaba un 0,07% y Unicaja Banco (UNI.MC) subía un 0,19%. Entre los grandes valores no financieros, Telefónica (TEF.MC) se anotaba un 0,84%, Inditex (ITX.MC) no tenía variación, Iberdrola (IBE.MC) se revalorizaba un 0,42%, Cellnex (CLNX.MC) ganaba un 0,75% y la petrolera Repsol (REP.MC) perdía un 0,03%. En el conjunto de la semana, el índice madrileño muestra un alza del 1,13%, tras dos semanas a la baja.

item.title: European stocks gain as Schneider lifts sentiment; inflation data awaited

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: European shares were on track for their biggest weekly gain since August on Friday, as a batch of strong earnings reports and signs of stability in battered global technology stocks bolstered investor sentiment. Industrials (.SXNP) gained 0.7% and were among the top gainers on the index. Chipmaker Aixtron (AIXGn.DE) advanced 4.8% after beating order intake estimates for the third quarter and confirming annual guidance. item.title: South African rand edges up as focus turns to next week's medium-term budget

item.content:encoded: The South African rand edged up in early trade on Friday as the dollar weakened, with investors focusing on next week's medium-term budget for clues on the country's fiscal outlook and credit-rating prospects. At 0712 GMT, the rand traded at 16.4450 against the dollar , about 0.3% firmer than its previous close. The dollar index , which measures the greenback against six major peers, was last down about 0.2%, putting the dollar on track for its first weekly decline in five weeks. Investors will be watching Finance Minister Enoch Godongwana's medium-term budget policy statement next week for indications of South Africa's fiscal trajectory, amid expectations of an improving budget balance and a more favourable ratings outlook. On the Johannesburg Stock Exchange, the Top-40 index (.JTOPI) was up about 0.2% in early trade. item.title: Trump dice que está manteniendo conversaciones con Rusia y China sobre desnuclearización
item.description: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, dijo el jueves que Washington está manteniendo conversaciones con Moscú y Pekín con el objetivo de desnuclearizar los países que cuentan con los mayores arsenales de armas nucleares.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, dijo el jueves que Washington está manteniendo conversaciones con Moscú y Pekín con el objetivo de desnuclearizar los países que cuentan con los mayores arsenales de armas nucleares. Rusia es el país con mayor número de ojivas nucleares almacenadas, seguida de Estados Unidos y China, según el Instituto Internacional de Investigación para la Paz de Estocolmo. Estados Unidos supera a Rusia en cuanto al número de ojivas desplegadas. Durante una entrevista con Newsmax, Trump dijo que espera que China "alcance" a Estados Unidos en los próximos cinco años. "Todo esto es una pena, porque me encantaría llevar a cabo la desnuclearización si fuera posible, pero, de hecho, estamos hablando con Rusia sobre ello, y también estamos hablando con China sobre esa desnuclearización", dijo Trump al medio. Newsmax informó de que Trump había hablado con el presidente chino, Xi Jinping, sobre la desnuclearización. Los comentarios de Trump se producen meses después de que el Tratado de Reducción de Armas Estratégicas (el Nuevo START) expirara este año. El tratado Nuevo START, firmado en 2010, permitía una única prórroga, que fue acordada por el expresidente Joe Biden y el presidente ruso Vladimir Putin por un periodo de cinco años. Cualquier nueva prórroga requeriría una decisión ejecutiva para ampliar voluntariamente los límites del tratado.

item.title: UK water regulator finds Severn Trent unit breached wastewater obligations

item.content:encoded: British regulator Ofwat said on Friday that it had found Hafren Dyfrdwy, a unit of Water utility Severn Trent (SVT.L) , in breach of its legal obligations over failures in the management of wastewater and sewage services. The water regulator's investigation found that Hafren Dyfrdwy failed to adequately provide drainage services and manage the contents of its sewer network, breaching its statutory duties Ofwat also found the company had previously breached licence requirements by failing to maintain adequate processes and systems, although it has since put those measures in place The company has proposed an enforcement package worth £280,000 ($372,652), which Ofwat has provisionally agreed to accept The enforcement package will be funded by the company and its shareholders, rather than customers, and must be delivered by 2030 ($1 = 0.7514 pounds)

item.title: China ready to cooperate with EU in tackling global imbalances
item.description: China is ready for dialogue with the European Union to improve communication on aspects of global economic governance and macro policy coordination, its finance minister told key bloc officials in Bangkok on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China is ready for dialogue with the European Union to improve communication on aspects of global economic governance and macro policy coordination, its finance minister told key bloc officials in Bangkok on Friday. Finance Minister Lan Foan made the remarks in a meeting with Valdis Dombrovskis, the EU economy and productivity commissioner, Christine Lagarde, the president of the European Central Bank and Kyriakos Pierrakakis, the Eurogroup president. Global imbalance was a "complex economic structural issue" that was increasingly influenced by non-economic factors such as geopolitics and protectionism, Lan said, according to a statement from his ministry. "All parties should view imbalances comprehensively, objectively," Lan added, urging open cooperation and coordination of macroeconomic policies, it said. Friday's meeting comes a week after [USN:L6N45V0LF TEXT:"a deal"] struck by China and the European Union to limit Chinese exports of hybrid cars to the bloc. The EU seeks to shrink its trade deficit with China that ballooned to €360 billion ($400 billion) in 2025.
